briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ TAP test reporter.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declaration for reporter_tap, a concrete implementation of the reporter abstract interface that formats test results according to the Test Anything Protocol (TAP), version 14.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, since the reporters are internal to the framework.
This file is included by micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h, which is the header that the applications include.
